announcements.title: Fall 2026 class routine published
announcements.body: The official Fall 2026 class & laboratory routine for Batch 29 – Batch 38 is now live. Students can generate their personalized routine from the Routine page. Any changes will be notified here.
announcements.created_by_name: Office of the Head, Dept. of Pharmacy

announcements.title: Batch 34 Pharmacology Lab rescheduled
announcements.body: The Pharmacology I laboratory session for Batch 34 Section A, Group A1 on Wednesday is cancelled this week. A replacement session will be announced shortly. Section B groups remain unchanged.

announcements.title: Guest lecture: Pharmacovigilance in Bangladesh
announcements.body: A guest lecture on "Pharmacovigilance in Bangladesh" by Dr. Abdul Karim Mahmud will be held for Batch 29 in the Seminar Hall, AB-501. Attendance is mandatory.

announcements.title: Mid-term examination schedule (Batch 29–33)
announcements.body: Mid-term examinations for Batch 29 – Batch 33 will commence from the third week of Fall 2026. Detailed exam routine will be published on the department notice board.

announcements.title: New students: Batch 37 & 38 orientation
announcements.body: Orientation for newly admitted Batch 37 and Batch 38 students will be held on the first Saturday of the semester at the permanent campus auditorium. Routine for Section A & B is available online.
